text_en: You must understand this, that in the last days distressing times will come.
text_cn: 你应知道：在末日，困难的时期必要来临，

text_en: For people will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
text_cn: 因为那时人只爱自己、爱钱、矜夸、骄傲、谩骂、不孝顺父母、忘恩、负义、不虔敬、

text_en: inhuman, implacable, slanderers, profligates, brutes, haters of good,
text_cn: 无慈爱、难和解、善诽谤、无节制、无仁心、不乐善、

text_en: treacherous, reckless, swollen with conceit, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
text_cn: 背信、鲁莽、自大、爱快乐胜过爱天主；

text_en: holding to the outward form of godliness but denying its power. Avoid them!
text_cn: 他们虽有虔敬的外貌，却背弃了虔敬的实质；这等人，你务要躲避。

text_en: For among them are those who make their way into households and captivate silly women, overwhelmed by their sins and swayed by all kinds of desires,
text_cn: 因为他们中，有的潜入人家中，猎取那些满身罪恶，及被各种邪欲吸引的妇女；

text_en: who are always being instructed and can never arrive at a knowledge of the truth.
text_cn: 这些妇女虽时常学习，但总达不到明白真理的地步。

text_en: As Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these people, of corrupt mind and counterfeit faith, also oppose the truth.
text_cn: 就如从前雅乃斯和杨布勒反抗梅瑟，照样这等人也反抗了真理。他们的心术败坏了，在信德上是不可靠的。

text_en: But they will not make much progress, because, as in the case of those two men, their folly will become plain to everyone.
text_cn: 但他们不能再有所成就，因为他们的愚昧将要暴露在众人前，如同那两个人一样。

text_en: Now you have observed my teaching, my conduct, my aim in life, my faith, my patience, my love, my steadfastness,
text_cn: 至于你，你却追随了我的教训、我度日的态度、志向、信心、坚忍、爱心、容忍、

text_en: my persecutions, and my suffering the things that happened to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
text_cn: 我受的迫害和苦难，即我在安提约基雅、依科尼雍、吕斯特辣所遭遇的事；那时我受了何等的迫害，主却从这一切迫害中救出了我。

text_en: Indeed, all who want to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
text_cn: 凡是愿意在基督耶稣内热心生活的人，都必要遭受迫害。

text_en: But wicked people and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving others and being deceived.
text_cn: 但是恶人和行诈术的人却越来越坏，他们迷惑人，也必受人迷惑。

text_en: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and firmly believed, knowing from whom you learned it,
text_cn: 然而你要坚持你所学和所信的事，你知道你是由谁学来的。

text_en: and how from childhood you have known the sacred writings that are able to instruct you for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 你自幼便通晓了圣经，这圣经能使你凭着那在基督耶稣内的信德，获得得救的智慧。

text_en: All scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
text_cn: 凡受天主默感所写的圣经，为教训、为督责、为矫正、为教导人学正义，都是有益的，

text_en: so that everyone who belongs to God may be proficient, equipped for every good work.
text_cn: 好使天主的人成全，适于行各种善工。
